misconceptions.description: Learner incorrectly assumes larger nuclei fuse more easily due to closer surface contact, overlooking the stronger Coulomb repulsion from higher charge.

evidence.evidence: Learner correctly identified that positive charges repel and that extra energy is needed to overcome this repulsion.
Learner correctly identified that the nucleus with 92 protons requires more energy due to stronger repulsion.
